[[Seitung Harbor]] | pic1 = [[Image:Saoshang Trail map.jpg|196px]] | pic1-text = Saoshang Trail | pic2 = [[File:Monastery 2.jpg|196px]] | pic2-text = Panaramic screenshot | ingame name=Saoshang Trail | game link type 0=explorable | game link num 0=313 }} The narrow [[Saoshang Trail]] curves with the southern edge of the central mountain range as it connects [[Shing Jea Monastery]] to [[Seitung Harbor]]. It is the only available pass that lies south of the mountains. The trail itself is not without dangers, as [[mantid]]s are known to wander the trail and hide in trees to ambush travelers. {{TOCright}} ==Getting there== [[Factions]] characters will be directed to take this trail to [[Seitung Harbor]] as part of the [[primary quest]] [[the Road Less Traveled]]. ==Shrines== ;[[Resurrection shrine]]s with a [[statue]]: *[[Melandru's Watcher]] **West, at the exit
